subject: Audit rights & evidence cadence — MSA / Order Form coordination
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@cloudmantle.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellie Zhang <ellie.zhang@cloudmantle.com>, Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@legalops.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Audit rights & evidence cadence — initial questions

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency/observability story. Legal asked me to follow up on one area before we advance the order form: the security exhibit / audit rights language in the MSA. A few specific asks from our side:

- Can you confirm Redwood's approach to SOC 2 evidence requests (what you can provide, typical turnaround)?
- What is your pen-test policy (frequency, scoping, and whether third-party reports can be shared)?
- We typically request an audit window and a 30–60 day notice period for on-site or remote evidence requests — is that acceptable?

I attached CloudMantle's standard security questionnaire to map against your exhibit. It'd be helpful to get a short playbook or cadence so we can lock dates into our procurement timeline. We're targeting a signature by 2026-12-03, so any redlines that affect timeframe would be material.

Thanks —
Jordan
Head of Cloud Security, CloudMantle
(jordan.price@cloudmantle.com)

Attachments: CloudMantle_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42 KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@cloudmantle.com>, Ellie Zhang <ellie.zhang@cloudmantle.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit rights & evidence cadence — initial questions

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick read-through here and a proposed next step: I'll loop legal + security with a concise redline we believe is reasonable for a SaaS inference platform, and propose a 1‑pager cadence doc that matches Redwood's current practice. High level answers now:

- SOC 2: we provide SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and a SOC 2 attestation letter upon request. Typical turnaround to provide report and supplements is 3–5 business days after receiving a formal request and signed NDA / data processing addendum where required.
- Pen test: Redwood conducts annual third‑party penetration tests and will share an executive summary; full detailed reports are considered privileged — we offer a redacted version under a mutual NDA or a controlled read-only session with our security team. We do not permit unfettered distribution.
- Audit rights / notice: We prefer to limit contractual audit rights to SOC 2 audits and one annual remote evidence request tied to the SOC 2 cycle. For customer‑initiated audits beyond that, we propose a scoped, mutually agreed plan with at least 30 days' advance notice and a maximum of 8 hours of Redwood engineering time billed if the request is outside normal operational evidence.

Next steps: Laura — can you take the attached security exhibit (v1) and produce a redline that: 1) codifies SOC 2 delivery commitments and exclusions; 2) defines pen-test sharing options; and 3) provides a short evidence cadence table (what we deliver, timing, and how often)? Marcus — can you add a short paragraph on the operational limits (eg, what logs we can provide, retention windows, and sanitized telemetry)?

Jordan / CloudMantle — would you be available for a 30‑minute sync next week to walk the redline? Karthik, I'll coordinate timing to keep the procurement milestone on track.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0197

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v2.docx (draft redline)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@cloudmantle.com>, Ellie Zhang <ellie.zhang@cloudmantle.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit rights & evidence cadence — redline summary and open points

Team / CloudMantle —

I reviewed the exhibit and prepared the redline summary below. Attached is a one‑page evidence cadence proposal (Audit_Evidence_Cadence_Proposal.pdf) and the redlined exhibit. High level summary:

1) SOC 2 access and evidence
- Commit to delivery of SOC 2 Type II report and datacenter/third‑party attestations where applicable within 3–5 business days of formal written request.
- Explicitly exclude live access to customer‑segregated production environments; evidence limited to reports, screenshots, and exported logs where feasible.

2) Penetration testing
- Redwood conducts annual third‑party pen tests; we will provide an executive summary to customers.
- Detailed penetration test artifacts (raw findings, exploits) are privileged. We propose a controlled disclosure option: either a redacted report under NDA or a 1‑hour readout + secure Q&A with our security team.

3) Audit rights & scope
- Limit contractual audit rights to: (a) SOC 2 / compliance attestations and (b) one scheduled remote evidence request per 12 months aligned with our SOC 2 cycle.
- For additional audits requested by customer, require (i) 30 days advance notice, (ii) written scope, and (iii) mutual agreement on time/billing for engineering involvement.

4) Evidence cadence (see attached pdf) — proposed items and delivery windows
- Quarterly: high level ops report (uptime, incident summary) — 5 business days
- Annually: SOC 2 Type II full report — 3–5 business days
- Ad‑hoc: specific exported logs or sanitized telemetry — 10–15 business days depending on scope

Open points for CloudMantle to confirm:
- Whether a controlled read‑only session is equivalent to receiving a redacted report for your internal audit requirements.
- Any specific regulatory constraints (eg, PCI / GLBA) that would require deviations from the above.

Jordan / Ellie — if you can confirm the two open points, we can finalize the exhibit and insert into the order form. Karthik — note that anything that expands the scope (eg, multiple annual audits, on‑site assessments) will need a pricing allowance in the order form (I recommend a tile in the Order Form for "Additional Audit/Assistance Hours" at an hourly rate).

– Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: Audit_Evidence_Cadence_Proposal.pdf (1 page), Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v2_redline.docx

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@cloudmantle.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellie Zhang <ellie.zhang@cloudmantle.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit rights & evidence cadence — redline summary and open points

Laura / team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear options. A few quick clarifications from our side after reviewing the one‑pager:

- The controlled read‑only session is acceptable to the auditors, provided we get a redacted report (executive findings) afterwards for our internal compliance record. Can Redwood commit to producing the redacted exec summary within 5 business days of the readout?
- For ad‑hoc log requests, our internal teams typically need a 45 day SLA to complete their cross‑checks; can Redwood commit to the mid‑range (15 business days) for standard-scope exports and provide an escalation path for critical items?
- If we need a second audit within a 12‑month period (rare, but possible for M&A activity), would Redwood consider a pre‑paid block of audit support hours on the order form (we can propose a $Xk block)?

If those answers are yes/okay, I think we can lock the security exhibit and move it into the MSA/order form this week. Happy to take the questions in a 30‑minute call if that's easier.

Best,
Jordan
Head of Cloud Security, CloudMantle
